packageRules.description: Renovate applies rules in order and later ones win, so the broad grouping goes first and the specific exceptions come last.
Major updates land on their own, so they can be reviewed one at a time.
Group GitHub Actions, including the composite action under .github/actions.
TypeScript and linting tooling. Matched by exact name rather than substring, so that @crossplane-org/function-sdk-typescript is not swept in here by the word 'typescript'.
Crossplane dependencies. Listed after the tooling rule so the TypeScript SDK ends up here rather than in that group.

The `typescript` dependency is aliased to @typescript/typescript6, so that typescript-eslint still has a JavaScript compiler API to import. TypeScript 7 is installed alongside it as @typescript/native and provides `tsc`. Do not let the TypeScript 6 alias be bumped across the major. Remove this rule, and the alias in functions/network/package.json, once typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.
